max: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a switch from deterministic fallback buckets to a lightweight stochastic sampler that picks fallback targets proportional to (weight * exp(-latency_slack)). Trying to avoid hot-spotting and make cold backups get used occasionally so they stay warm. open to pushback.

sasha: curious — how would we reproduce request routing for debugging? stochastic = harder to trace. :thinking_face:

jordan: agree w/ sasha. Could we keep an optional per-request seed in headers so we can replay? e.g. X-Routing-Seed. If absent default to time-based.

max: yeah planning to surface seed in traces. default path deterministic unless tenant enables "stochastic_preference" flag. seed will appear in trace/span tags.

anya: two operational concerns: 1) billing churn if we start touching cheaper fallbacks more often, 2) SLO noise from occasional slower picks. We should gate for tenant tiers.

opencost-bot: cost-sim job finished for branch "stochastic-fallback-try" — baseline vs sample: +0.7% token-cost overall, heavy skew on low-traffic tenants. (report: /link/cost-sim-408888)

lee: telemetry note: when sampler picks non-primary route we need a way to correlate the request to the sampler decision, otherwise the logs look like random slow calls. Propose adding fields to request_log: routing_decision={primary|sample}, routing_seed, chosen_route, expected_p90_estimate.

max: agreed. sketch of sampler pseudocode to discuss:
```
// input: candidates [{route, weight, p90}]
for c in candidates:
  score[c] = weight * exp(-max(0, (p90 - latency_slo))/slop)
choice = weighted_random_choice(score, seed)
```
Will tune "slop" per-tenant.

sasha: still worried about debugging flakiness. Suggest we keep deterministic fallback (old behavior) behind a feature-flag rollout: day 0 enable for internal tenants, day 7 expand to paid tiers, day 14 to self-serve if metrics look stable. Also add a control metric: fraction_of_requests_sampled_by_tenant.

jordan: one more thing — when sampler drops to a route that doesn't support a particular model quantization or seq-length, we must have a quick compatibility check to avoid hard failures. Fallback must be compatibility-first.

anya: +1 on rollout cadence. I'll own the cost gating and will add a budget-aware kill-switch in the console if simulated cost > threshold.

max: planned action items: 
- max: land proto + unit tests (WIP) by Friday
- sasha: define replay plan + trace fields (EOD Tue)
- anya: cost thresholds + kill-switch config (EOD Wed)
- lee: logging schema PR for routing_decision fields (tomorrow)
- jordan: compatibility-check matrix into runtime (PR next week)

max: thanks all. if nobody objects I'll create a short RFC note and add a tiny sim harness to the routing repo. :rocket:
